# Frankly Financial

> Frankly Financial provides bookkeeping, financial reporting, and tax support for
> small businesses in Toronto and across Canada. Plain-English service: monthly
> bookkeeping, CFO-grade reports, HST and corporate tax filing support.

Website: https://franklyfinancial.co
Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada
Contact: hello@franklyfinancial.co

## Services
- Monthly bookkeeping for small businesses
- Financial reports and KPI dashboards
- Corporate tax (T2) and HST filing support
- Catch-up bookkeeping for businesses behind on their books
- Payroll support

## Guides (plain-English, updated for 2026 Canadian tax rules)
- [Toronto Bookkeeping and Accounting Services Compared](https://franklyfinancial.co/blog/best-bookkeeping-accounting-services-toronto): the published 2026 prices of the Toronto firms that post them (AIS Solutions, Enkel, Frankly Financial, Insight Accounting CPA, Outsource Bookkeeping), with the inclusion methodology and a disclosure that Frankly Financial is one of the firms listed
- [How to Choose a Small Business Accountant in Toronto](https://franklyfinancial.co/blog/small-business-accountant-toronto): costs by seller type (freelance, firm, CPA), bookkeeper vs. CPA, hiring questions
- [Bookkeeping Services in Toronto: Costs & Options](https://franklyfinancial.co/blog/bookkeeping-services-toronto): 2026 pricing, DIY vs. outsourced
- [How Much Does a Bookkeeper Cost in Canada?](https://franklyfinancial.co/blog/bookkeeper-cost-canada): 2026 hourly and monthly flat rates, in-house vs. outsourced vs. DIY
- [Corporate Tax Filing in Toronto: The T2 Guide](https://franklyfinancial.co/blog/corporate-tax-filing-toronto): deadlines, the 11.2% small business rate effective July 1 2026
- [How to File a T2 Corporate Tax Return in Toronto: Step by Step](https://franklyfinancial.co/blog/how-to-file-t2-corporate-tax-return-toronto): the ten-step filing walkthrough, GIFI schedules 100/125/141, which T2 schedules apply to whom, T2 Short eligibility, the exact conditions for the three-month balance-due day, instalment exemptions, and the Ontario annual return that has been filed separately through the Ontario Business Registry since 2021
- [HST for Ontario Small Businesses](https://franklyfinancial.co/blog/hst-small-business-ontario): $30,000 threshold and exactly which revenue counts toward it, registration deadlines, filing and payment due dates by reporting period, the late-filing penalty formula (1% plus 0.25% per month to 4%), the $250 demand-to-file and $100/$250 paper-filing penalties, 7% daily compounding interest, Quick Method
- [Sole Proprietorship vs. Incorporation in Ontario](https://franklyfinancial.co/blog/incorporation-vs-sole-proprietorship-ontario): tax math and when incorporating pays off
- [Salary vs. Dividends in Canada](https://franklyfinancial.co/blog/salary-vs-dividends-canada): how to pay yourself from your corporation, 2026 CPP and RRSP numbers, the Ontario dividend tax credit change effective January 1 2027
- [Small Business Tax Write-Offs in Canada](https://franklyfinancial.co/blog/small-business-tax-deductions-canada): 2026 deduction checklist
- [Payroll for Small Businesses in Ontario](https://franklyfinancial.co/blog/payroll-small-business-ontario): 2026 CPP/EI numbers, remittance schedules, T4s, WSIB (10-day registration deadline, $1.23 per $100 average 2026 premium rate, $121,700 earnings ceiling, construction rules) and EHT, plus Ontario minimum wage rising to $17.95 on October 1 2026 and the 44-hour overtime threshold
- [Catch-Up Bookkeeping for Toronto Businesses](https://franklyfinancial.co/blog/catch-up-bookkeeping-toronto): costs, CRA penalties, how many years back to go, and the Voluntary Disclosures Program relief tiers in effect since October 1 2025
